requirements.description: One server-committed eight-step peg path produces a transparent terminal bucket, multiplier, payout, and net result.
requirements.notes: Issue #77 allocates the permanent distinct rules requirement for issue #136.

requirements.description: Authenticated sessions own private reload-safe drops, durable receipts, settled history, and canonical route restoration.
requirements.notes: Session context overrides caller player ids and committed results survive reload and process restart.

requirements.description: Wager debits and returned-token credits use the shared ledger exactly once under durable action identities.
requirements.notes: No game code mutates balances directly and conflicting retries fail closed.

requirements.description: Plinko supplies complete English and Russian responsive, accessible, reduced-motion-safe, timer-clean play.
requirements.notes: Evidence covers both locales and every governed viewport.

requirements.description: Catalog, contract, browser, and long-suite discovery include Plinko with requirement, module, version, and visual traceability.
requirements.notes: Descriptor sort order 230 and the catalog-discovered long driver are canonical.

requirements.description: Plinko publishes prepared drops, durable action receipts, debit and settlement recovery markers, terminal history, and rejected-debit rollback through provider-current callbacks that replace only game-owned fields. Competing processes preserve unrelated player-state siblings and fail closed before a stale drop or cleanup can overwrite the winning history, while the frozen v1 envelope, peg-path math, multiplier profile, and exactly-once ledger movements remain unchanged.
requirements.notes: The frozen v1 contract, committed eight-step path, multiplier profile, ledger transaction types, and action keys remain unchanged. Production multiworker activation stays blocked because wallet and game-state publication remain separate durable boundaries.
